div.div: شَبِيحَةٌ sing. of شَبَائِحُ, (O,) which signifies Pieces of wood, (O, K,) broad, (O,) placed transversly, (O, K,) contrariwise, or on contrary sides, (O,) in the [camel's saddle called] قَتَب (O, K) that is of wood: so expl. by Shujáa. (O.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
